title: 8-Track Heaven
summary: 8-Track Heaven was a website dedicated to 8-track cartridges and equipment, founded in July 1995 by Malcolm Riviera, Abigail Lavine, Russ Forster, and Chip Rowe. It served enthusiasts with free ads, tips, and links. The site profiled 8-track album releases during the 1990s, published the documentary film "So Wrong They're Right" in 1995, and maintained a Twitter presence until the domain expired in 2024 following Riviera's death circa 2023.

mechanisms.title: Enthusiast resource provision
mechanisms.explanation: The site offered free advertisements, practical tips, and curated links to assist collectors and fans of 8-track cartridges and associated equipment.

mechanisms.title: Cultural documentation and media production
mechanisms.explanation: 8-Track Heaven profiled 1990s 8-track album releases and produced the documentary film "So Wrong They're Right," which won best feature-length documentary at the 1995 Chicago Underground Film Festival.
